scientific_integrity: Analytical contraction, exchangeability, and symbolic IFS proofs; finite rational checks are transcription guards, not infinite proof. Priority assessed from material inspected with stated historical risks.
scientific_limitations: Exact equal-curvature scalar finite-sum moment identity; the atomic-versus-singular stationary comparison is for four centers (1,1,-1,-1), two batches of size two. The full-support singularity is proved at r=1/3, and other fractal claims only for 0<r<1/3. This is not a generic convergence-rate result; no independent audit or exhaustive priority verification.
title: Equal mean-square risk conceals an atomic-to-singular divide in fresh minibatch reshuffling
